title: ChatGPT, Cursor and Vercel: A Fast AI Website Workflow

facts.fact: The article 'Build Websites in Minutes: The Ultimate AI Workflow Using ChatGPT, Cursor, and Vercel' was published on January 17, 2026.
According to the article, Vercel automatically rebuilds a linked site every time changes are pushed to the connected GitHub repository.
facts.quote: Vercel automatically builds your site every time you push changes to your GitHub repository.

facts.fact: The article describes Vercel as a platform for deploying web applications quickly and easily.
facts.quote: A platform for deploying web applications quickly and easily.

facts.fact: The article describes Cursor as a collaborative coding tool that simplifies writing and testing code snippets.
facts.quote: A collaborative coding tool that simplifies writing and testing code snippets.
